source: icons-src/tecton/*.ts (Tecton icon export); gallery order from tecton-screenshots/059_components-icon__icon-gallery.png
notes: Labels in the gallery carry an 'Icon' suffix (e.g. 'AddCircleIcon'); 'label' preserves the exact text, 'name' strips the suffix. Gallery header: 'Tecton Icons', with Variant toggle (Outlined | Filled), Size toggle (Small (16px) | Medium (20px) | Large (24px)) and a 'Search icons' text field; screenshot shows Outlined + Medium (20px) selected. Icons are listed in alphabetical order, 9 per row. StrataIcon renders in colour (pink/orange gradient top layer); all others are monochrome. The vendored export is trimmed to the oil & gas / subsurface domain glyphs; the general-purpose glyphs of the Tecton set are covered by lucide-react and are not vendored. The build additionally generates only `domain: true` entries, so dropping in a fresh full export still ships just the domain set.
